description: Unit test class for the ModifyAttributes class, testing JSON serialization, equality, immutability, constructor validation, and handling of large attributes.

classes.name: ModifyAttributesTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the ModifyAttributes class, including JSON serialization, equality, and behavior under edge cases.

methods.name: assertImmutability

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAttribute
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ModifyAttributes instance with null attributes throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that an instance can be created from valid JSON input.
